# Aimensa

> > Aimensa provides AI-powered educational tools and neural network applications for problem-solving, content creation, and mental health support.

Operated by NUMUX TECH Ltd in London, Aimensa offers free AI tools including physics and mechanics problem solvers, marketing agents, mental health support, and rap generation. The site also features comprehensive guides on AI video generation, model training, and enterprise development workflows using technologies like OpenAI, LoRA, and multi-model orchestration platforms.
